Amblycerus insuturatus and two species of birds, Ara ararauna (Linnaeus, 1758) and Ara chloropterus (Gray, 1859) were recognized as pre-dispersal seed predators of the Buchenavia tomentosa (Combretaceae) by Farias et al. (2015). According to the authors, the seed beetles were found in fruits collected directly from the crown of trees and about 2.79 % of the fruits had signs of emergence, with endosperm and embryo completely consumed.
